llm.summary: The skill's code, instructions, and resource usage are consistent with an internet-radio controller: it spawns mpv/ffplay, calls the Radio Browser API, and stores local preferences — it does not request unrelated credentials or perform unexpected network exfiltration.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (internet radio playback, station search, favorites, volume, pause/resume, stop/next/now) align with the included CLI script, built-in stations, and use of mpv/ffplay. Declared optional dependencies (mpv/ffplay/jq/curl) match the functionality.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and scripts only instruct playing streams, searching Radio Browser, managing a local prefs file, and controlling playback. The runtime instructions reference the expected files and env overrides (AGENT_RADIO_BASE_DIR, AGENT_RADIO_PREF_FILE, AGENT_RADIO_STATIONS_FILE). There are no instructions to read unrelated system files, access other credentials, or transmit data to unexpected endpoints (network calls are to radio stream URLs and the radio-browser API).
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is an instruction-only skill with a bundled shell script; there is no installer that downloads arbitrary code. SKILL.md suggests installing mpv/ffmpeg via brew, which is reasonable. No high-risk remote downloads or extract steps are present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment credentials. The small set of environment variables it documents are local overrides for file locations (base dir, prefs, stations), which are appropriate for a local CLI tool. The script checks for jq/curl/mpv/ffplay at runtime and fails politely if missing.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill persists a local preferences.json and records playback PIDs across runs (expected for playback state). It does not request persistent 'always' inclusion or modify other skills. Because it spawns background player processes and writes files in its directory (or override dirs), users should ensure they are comfortable with that local persistence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do exactly what it says: play internet radio, search the Radio Browser directory, and save local preferences. Before installing, verify you are comfortable with: (1) the skill writing a preferences.json file in the skill directory (or an overridden path via AGENT_RADIO_BASE_DIR / AGENT_RADIO_PREF_FILE), (2) it spawning background media player processes (mpv or ffplay) that will access network stream URLs, and (3) it making HTTPS calls to the Radio Browser API (de1.api.radio-browser.info) during station search. No credentials are requested. If you want extra caution, inspect scripts/radio.sh yourself, run the script in a restricted environment first, and ensure jq/curl/mpv/ffplay are installed from trusted sources.
